question:
Let
\[
a_n=\frac{2^3-1}{2^3+1}\times\frac{3^3-1}{3^3+1}\times\cdots\times\frac{n^3-1}{n^3+1},\qquad n\ge2.
\]
Then $\lim_{n\to\infty}a_n$
solution:
Factor each term as
\[
\frac{r^3-1}{r^3+1}=\frac{r-1}{r+1}\cdot\frac{r^2+r+1}{r^2-r+1}.
\]
The two products telescope, giving the limit $\frac23$.
